page.title: Soy sauce
page.meta_title: Soy sauce (Sushi) — Item, lore & connections | Ton-o-Lore
page.meta_description: Soy sauce is the salt of the sushi counter. Edomae chefs often brush it on the fish so the rice is not dunked to pieces. Related pages: Nigiri.
page.content:
Shoyu used as a dip or a brush for nigiri.

How Soy sauce connects

  • Item: Nigiri — Soy sauce is brushed or dabbed on nigiri rather than used to soak the rice.

What is Soy sauce?

Soy sauce is the salt of the sushi counter. Edomae chefs often brush it on the fish so the rice is not dunked to pieces.

Key threads lead to Nigiri.
